steps.description:
For a car to be driverless, safety must be the top priority, while reaching the destination remains the primary objective. A fully functional driverless car requires cameras for image processing, along with multiple ultrasonic sensors for close-range object detection.

While you may not be able to create a fully functional driverless car yet, we can have fun simulating a simple one. Observe how the robot moves autonomously (without manual control) in the clip below. Create a program that can perform similarly.
